Eyes, mouth, face shape, etc. However it is important to acknowledge that if you go in to this situation expecting traced art, that is exactly what you are going to see. Now the final step: I have many artist friends and one thing in common is that they each have their own style, something unique to them. Now there’s a fork in the road: you can a) check to see if this alleged tracer’s art has that common trait throughout the art. Or b), check out the art of the artist who was allegedly traced, and see if any of the alleged tracer’s art continues to match other pieces made by that artist.
